findings.detail: Cloud Shell Git rejected the :!_audit/** exclusion expression.
workers/narrator-worker/index.js imports firebase-admin, initializes it, reads jobs from Firestore, writes jobResults and updates job status.

correctiveActions: Replace unsupported pathspec exclusions with portable grep output filtering.
Retain and upgrade firebase-admin for asset-worker and narrator-worker.
Remove only unused firebase-admin declarations from spatial-worker and studio-worker.
Generate execution receipt URAI-WSC-20260711-JOBS-DEPENDENCY-AUDIT-015 only after all corrected gates pass.
